# Chert SDK

> Open-source clients for Chert iMessage messaging and the Chert FaceTime control plane. `@trychert/sdk` (npm, CLI `chert-sdk`) and `chert-sdk` (PyPI, import `trychert`) are published; Rust, .NET, C++ and Go are source previews. The SDK does not relay media itself; `@trychert/sdk/media` (unreleased source preview) adds frame validation, a bounded video source and WHIP/WHEP signaling for your own WebRTC peer connection; it, living services and screen sharing are unreleased drafts (#17, #18, #25). Putting a LiveKit voice or video agent on a FaceTime line uses the separate `chert` CLI from `@trychert/facetime`.

Rules for coding agents:

- Run `chert-sdk context` (or `npx --package=@trychert/sdk chert-sdk context`) first. It prints JSON with the SDK version, which credentials are set (never their values), FaceTime identity and lines, and docs links. `--offline` makes no requests.
- Credentials are per service: `CHERT_API_KEY` (iMessage), `CHERT_FACETIME_TOKEN` plus `CHERT_PROJECT_ID` (FaceTime). They are not interchangeable. Never print or commit them.
- `chert-sdk imessage send` needs `--confirm` and a stable `--idempotency-key`. Send only to recipients who agreed, and only when the user asked.
- Nothing retries automatically. A queued receipt is not delivery; an accepted call is not a connected call. Reconcile before retrying.
- The SDK does not allocate lines. It can read billing status and start a checkout only with a signed-in user session and explicit user intent. Terminal billing (`chert-sdk billing buy|switch|card|cancel`, CLI credential with the `billing` scope) is an unreleased draft the backend does not serve yet; never buy or switch plans without the user's explicit request, and open returned Stripe URLs only for the user.
- FaceTime calls can carry audio and video (calls can also be audio-only). Video needs a line with `supports_video`, a FaceTime Video call, and an agent that publishes a camera track.
- Custom video (WHIP/WHEP), living services and screen sharing are unreleased drafts (PRs #17, #18, #25); do not use them from a published package.
- `chert-sdk` has no `login`, `onboard`, `new` or `dev` command; those belong to the `chert` CLI from `@trychert/facetime`.

## Docs

- [Setup](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md): install, credentials, `context`, first requests, existing and shared lines, voice and video, the agent CLI, limits
- [README](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/README.md): language status, JavaScript API, CLI commands, events and webhooks, migration notes
- [FaceTime notes](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/docs/FACETIME.md): control-plane scope and media boundaries
- [FaceTime client](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/packages/control-plane/README.md): typed FaceTime methods
- [Python guide](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/python/README.md): `chert-sdk` on PyPI

## Optional

- [Provider compatibility](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md): supported subsets for the provider adapters and `chert-sdk adopt`
- [Rust](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/rust/README.md), [.NET](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/dotnet/README.md), [C++](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/cpp/README.md), [Go](https://github.com/cherthq/sdk/blob/main/go/README.md): source-preview guides
- [`@trychert/facetime` on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@trychert/facetime): the `chert` agent CLI (beta)
